items.title: Claude Code now appends a link to a Claude session in every commit
items.why_it_matters: Claude Code now automatically appends a private session URL to every git commit message by default. Since you are building AI-ingest with strict commit discipline, these auto-generated links will clutter your clean Git history. Open your terminal and run `claude config set attribution.sessionUrl false` today to disable this behavior and keep your commit logs clean.

items.title: Show HN: Turn repeated coding-agent corrections into rules/skills
items.why_it_matters: A new desktop app called Blume sits next to Claude Code and Codex to turn repeated agent mistakes into persistent rules and skills. As a vibe coder, your job is to direct the AI; Blume helps you stop repeating yourself when Claude forgets your Next.js or Supabase setup and writes duplicate functions. Download Blume this week and connect it to your AI-ingest project to automatically generate a `CLAUDE.md` file based on your actual chat corrections.

items.title: Show HN: Decispher – persistent engineering context and memory for coding agents
items.why_it_matters: Decispher launched as a context and memory layer that feeds your engineering history, like commits and PRs, back to coding agents. Instead of wasting tokens or having Claude guess your project's architecture, Decispher helps your agent understand the decisions you've already made in your repo. Connect Decispher to your AI-ingest GitHub repository this week so Claude Code can reference your past commits when writing new features.

items.title: Claude Red Bar (visual and audible notifier of task completion)
items.why_it_matters: A developer built Claude Red Bar, a simple utility that gives you a visual and audible alert when Claude Code finishes a long-running task. Waiting for Claude Code to finish writing complex Next.js pages can tempt you to open Twitter and get distracted; this keeps you focused on shipping. Clone the repository and install the utility today so you get a clear ping the moment Claude finishes generating your next feature.

items.title: Config-drift-checker: regression tests for your Claude Code setup
items.why_it_matters: Config-drift-checker is a new tool that runs regression tests on your custom Claude Code configurations and system prompts. As you tweak your agent instructions to build AI-ingest, it's easy to accidentally break old rules that were working fine. Run this checker against your current `CLAUDE.md` file this week to verify that your instructions remain consistent as you add new features.
